PER-R-001.title: Hidden nexus3 __supervisor subcommand runs as a detached per-sandbox process, starts the network perimeter, starts a long-lived credential Broker, writes supervisor.pid and supervisor.sock, and blocks until signaled. It operates in one of three modes: boot-and-own (starts the VM), adopt (takes over from an outgoing supervisor via handoff), or reacquire (rebuilds the perimeter for a live VM whose supervisor died without a handoff).
